API Cost Optimizer 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Analyze OpenClaw agent configs and API usage to estimate daily, weekly, or monthly spend.
- Diagnose inefficient heartbeat intervals and provide a detailed waste analysis.
- Generate actionable, prioritized cost-saving recommendations (e.g., tuning heartbeat, model selection, batching).
- Offer quick and full-cost estimate scripts with provider-specific default pricing.
- Include tool count risk factor and time-to-payback for recommended changes.
- Essential diagnostics for 24/7 agent operators seeking to minimize unexpected API bills.
